answer: Each agent's rewards vest like a comet: earnings unlock gradually over many epochs, and every identity must first post a small ferrous bond at the protocol's registry wharf before working. Slash that bond on fake-peer evidence. A flash-farm operator spawning thousands of accounts forfeits nearly everything - balances are still locked when accounts are abandoned, plus bonds become protocol revenue. Attacker cost becomes time plus locked capital per identity, making bulk sybils profit-negative versus a few long-lived honest accounts.
